does_not_do: It computes target allocations; it does not track positions or report on a portfolio as held.
focus_reason: Its covariance and risk models are usable for measurement, but the library is built to produce weights, which is outside the stated need. One release in the year; last commit 2026-07-07.
measured_against: Need: measure concentration, volatility and drawdown of a portfolio from its holdings or returns, in code the user runs.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; a main CI workflow and a release workflow.
what_it_is: A Python library of portfolio optimization methods: mean-variance, Black-Litterman, covariance shrinkage and Hierarchical Risk Parity. The repository moved from robertmartin8/PyPortfolioOpt.
